opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead research and email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then compose a hiring lead email summarizing followers, top repo, stars, language and latest post for a given role.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username
Press Enter and click the 'Users' results filter
Note followers, repo stars, language and latest post
Open mail compose and enter To hiring@example.com
Enter body '<username>: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <post>.'

opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, check the archive.org Wayback snapshot of their company's site for a given year, and save a summary note.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia
Open archive.org Wayback Machine and enter the company domain
Pick the year and a day snapshot
Add a note combining the facts in the notes app
